instructions: Copy one of the example profiles above and paste it into config.json
Remove the outer 'exampleProfiles' wrapper - only keep the profile object
Save the file and the service will automatically reload the configuration
You can mix group names (fps, arrows, fkeys, etc.) with individual key names
Color format is hex RGB: RRGGBB (e.g., FF0000 = red, 00FF00 = green, 0000FF = blue)

logLevelOptions.Warning: Default - Only logs warnings and errors (recommended for normal use)
logLevelOptions.Information: Detailed logging - Logs all operations (use when debugging issues)
logLevelOptions.Error: Only errors - Minimal logging, only critical errors
logLevelOptions.Debug: Very detailed - Includes debug information (very verbose)
logLevelOptions.Note: Change 'logLevel' in config.json to adjust logging verbosity. Service restart required for changes to take effect.

availableGroups.media: Media control keys (play, stop, next, previous)
availableGroups.system: System keys (print screen, scroll lock, pause, insert, home, page up/down, delete, end)

macroKeys.description: Program P1-P5 (and FN+P1-FN+P5) to send key combos or sequences. Macros are stored on the keyboard MCU and persist across power cycles.
macroKeys.validKeys: p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, fn+p1, fn+p2, fn+p3, fn+p4, fn+p5
macroKeys.availableModifiers: ctrl, shift, alt, win, rctrl, rshift, ralt, altgr, rwin
macroKeys.availableKeys: a-z, 0-9, f1-f24, enter, esc, backspace, tab, space, -, =, [, ], \, ;, ', `, comma, ., /, capslock, printscreen, scrolllock, pause, insert, home, pageup, delete, end, pagedown, right, left, down, up, numlock, numpad0-numpad9, numpad+, numpad-, numpad*, numpad/, numpadenter, numpad., menu
